AdrenoMetal.comparison_base_kind: previously observed upstream selection; not the build pin

decisions: Keep all source pins and the exact firmware memory patch. Both component API comparisons are diverged; the shallow core cache cannot establish a complete ancestry relation. Exact tree changes and selected direct source differences were inspected without reporting visible history as a linear update.

Core changes include firmware/toolchain and archive-provider preflight, local verified-root policy validation, failed-rebuild packaging refusal, macOS Shader Cache application registration and another Metal runtime. The selected native route already checks exact dependency/artifact hashes and signed root inputs. No broad generic build-driver upgrade or macOS addon is imported.

Selected ArmCpu sleep support adds a weak platform-sleep hook, PSCI conduit/core-off handling, GIC/timer handling and board prepare/restore callbacks. It still requires a Darwin22 hook and CPH2653 PMGR/wake/resource ownership adaptation; the current single-core/no-sleep policy remains.

The selected Metal comparison spans 164 commits/91 files with diverged history. Its bridge and runtime/capture source was sampled, not fully audited or rebased against the pinned iPhone frontend/runtime ABI.

Pagani drivers, GOP, GENI and native A830 observed tips remain unchanged. ArmSmmu4K main remains at the previously observed 83969cd8, while the matched A830/SMMU build pins stay at 1a132105/3ba92451. No unmatched API update is selected.
scope: Six remote references and targeted source/tree comparisons supplement earlier snapshots. The complete component histories, all older repositories and hardware behavior are not qualified.
